content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Crypto payment

The architecture behind crypto payment gateways for digital products is designed to empower creators by eliminating reliance on traditional payment platforms. This approach provides a complete stack that enables seamless transactions using cryptocurrencies. By leveraging NOWPayments, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, ensuring that financial barriers become a thing of the past. This infrastructure not only supports digital products like ebooks and courses but also protects your earnings from high platform fees, allowing you to focus on your creative work.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At the core of this payment infrastructure is a combination of free tools and services that work harmoniously to facilitate automated payment processing. Using platforms like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, you can manage orders effectively. Supabase or Google Sheets acts as your order storage, while Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 handles file delivery. This stack allows for instant product access upon payment confirmation through NOWPayments, ensuring a smooth user experience for both creators and their customers.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators in regions restricted by conventional payment gateways. Whether you're in Nigeria, Kenya, or Venezuela, the solution provides you with the tools to build an online store without the constraints of high fees or platform reliance. By utilizing this architecture, you take ownership of your business and ensure that every sale is processed directly under your control, enabling you to reach a global audience without barriers.
NOWPayments charges just 0.5%, compared to Gumroad's 10%.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The effectiveness of this architecture lies in its integrated components. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages provide free hosting, ensuring that your digital products are accessible. The backend logic processed through Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script allows for real-time order management. With Supabase or Google Sheets for storage and NOWPayments for payment processing, you have a powerful, cost-effective solution. Each component enhances the overall functionality, creating a streamlined, automated system that works for you.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy this infrastructure, start by selecting your hosting service, either GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up your backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Load your products into Supabase or Google Sheets for easy order management. Integrate NOWPayments for seamless payment processing. Each step is designed to empower you and ensure a smooth transition from concept to deployment, enabling you to sell your digital products effectively.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by using a crypto payment gateway like NOWPayments. This allows you to accept payments in various cryptocurrencies, which can be converted to USD at transaction time. With low fees and no platform dependencies, you can maintain complete control over your sales.
Complete ownership of your digital commerce stack means no ongoing fees.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, and beats often reach this infrastructure question after hitting payout restrictions or platform policy problems on Gumroad, Payhip, or Lemon Squeezy. The difference with a sovereign stack is structural: there is no platform relationship to manage, no content policy to comply with, and no payout schedule to wait on. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys the complete infrastructure in 48 hours under your own accounts. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the build process for creators who prefer to self-deploy. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I integrate NOWPayments with my digital products?

To integrate NOWPayments, you'll need to set up an account with them and obtain your API keys. Next, incorporate these keys into your backend logic, either with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, to facilitate payment processing for your products.
What are the advantages of using crypto payments for digital products?

Crypto payments eliminate the high fees associated with traditional platforms and provide immediate transaction confirmations. This means you can get paid faster and keep more of your earnings, allowing for better profitability on each sale.
Can I sell multiple types of digital products using this architecture?

Yes, this infrastructure supports various digital products, including ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, and software. You can set up your store to handle different product types, ensuring a versatile selling platform.
What if I need support after deployment?

Our Sovereign Starter Stack and Edge Commerce Stack come with 30 days of support post-deployment. This ensures you have the necessary guidance to troubleshoot any issues and optimize your store's performance.
Is my customer data secure with this setup?
Yes, since you own the entire infrastructure, you maintain control over your customer data. There are no third-party platforms involved that could compromise your data security.
